author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
In this video, you'll see how to build a complete small business website using GoDaddy Airo AI Builder, an affordable AI website builder where you describe your business in your own words and it builds the whole thing for you — pages, copy, images, and even a working booking form. Check out Airo AI Builder: https://social.godaddy/4g15rvU
 
You'll learn how to:
- Describe your business in plain, everyday language and get a full website back
- Answer a couple of quick questions so Airo builds to your style and tone
- Use Annotate to point at one thing on the page and have Airo change it
- Make bigger changes — colors, copy, whole new sections — just by asking
- Add a working booking page with a real backend that emails you every request
- Preview your site on desktop, tablet, and phone before you go live
